data.long_meaning: The name Hannoria is derived from the Greek word 'hannos' which means 'mountain'. This name is a feminine form of Hannes, a Greek name meaning 'graceful mountain'. In Christian tradition, this name represents the strength and grace of God, as if He is a mountain that provides protection and stability. The name Hannoria carries the meaning “Graceful mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Hannoria usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
